avoid: Using solid wooden sticks for martial sparring
children.counts: Count 1-2-3 forward steps with exaggerated knee bends.
children.game_version: Play a leader-follower game led by a designated 'Sarčupi' who changes scarf movement patterns on drum cues.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm bends and hand/scarf waving movements while seated in a chair, executing simplified forward toe taps.
seniors.standing_version: Perform Sangin-Samâ slow steps while holding a secure handrail or partner's hand, avoiding rapid speed shifts.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a slow, constant tempo without accelerating into Dopâ; restrict footwork to small steps.

learning_units.description: Learn the Sangin-Samâ step pattern: cross right foot over left, step forward twice, touch left toe to ground, and align left foot beside right.
Learn the Sepâ three-step forward pattern starting on the right foot with coordinated knee bending.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Pinky fingers linked at shoulder height, or waving colorful scarves held in both hands.
movement_profile.footwork: Right foot crosses left, two steps forward, left toe touch to side, stepping forward right-left-right with knee flexion.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular chain lead by a Sarčupi, moving counter-clockwise or in place; or paired central dueling space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso following directional step movements.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Grounded footwork in Čupi mass dances; high vertical explosive leaps in Čubâzi.
movement_profile.partnering: Linked hands/fingers in mass circle; attacker and defender pairs in Čubâzi.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, shoulder-to-shoulder contact in circular lines with elbows bent.

signature_moves.description: Cross right foot over left, step forward twice, touch left toe to ground, and align feet.
signature_moves.name: Sangin-Samâ step

signature_moves.description: Three forward steps starting on the right foot followed by knee flexion.
signature_moves.name: Sepâ step

signature_moves.description: High vertical jump performed by a defender to dodge a stick strike aimed below the knees.
signature_moves.name: Čubâzi leap

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Gradual buildup from deliberate, heavy stepping to high-energy rapid footwork.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid breaking the locked hand-holding line in Čupi; in Čubâzi, strikes must never target above the knee.

music_profile.musical_form: Sectional acceleration continuum transitioning from Sangin-Samâ to Sepâ, Dopâ, and returning to Sangin-Samâ.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Slow steady pulse accelerating into rapid driving drum strikes.
music_profile.sound_description: A driving combination of resonant outdoor horn calls (karnâ), melodic fiddle lines, and heavy drum strikes that steadily build in speed to propel circle dancers.
music_profile.vocal_style: Audience cheering, screaming, and whistling accompanying instrumental music.

basic_steps: Cross the right foot over the left foot.
Touch the tip of the left toe to the ground.
Bring the left foot beside the right foot.
Transition into three forward steps starting with the right foot (Sepâ phase).
teaching.formation: Closed or open circular ring (Čupi) shoulder-to-shoulder, or paired duet arrangement (Čubâzi).
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with the foot placement and cross-steps of Sangin-Samâ before trying faster tempo shifts.
teaching.rhythm: Progressive acceleration starting with a slow steady tempo (Sangin-Samâ), speeding up to a medium three-step meter (Sepâ), and reaching a fast peak (Dopâ).
